info.title: Mirabi API - Study Together
info.description: Subset of the live OpenAPI document (/docs). Regenerate with backend/scripts/export_study_together_openapi.py.

post.description:
The short profile behind an exact friend code (typed, or read from a friend QR code "MIRABI-FRIEND:<code>").
The code goes in the body, not the URL, so it stays out of access logs.
Join from an invitation or a friend's code room listed on the Study Together home.
Presence for clients without a WebSocket; returns the snapshot so it doubles as the polling fallback.
Pet emotes and quick cheers: a fixed set (no free text), never stored, rate limited.

get.description: One invitation with its current `state`, also after it expired or its room closed (opened from a notification).
Newest page first by cursor; items are returned oldest → newest for display.

delete.description: Unsend your own message, or (host) remove anyone's message in your room. Retry-safe.

get.description:
A friend's saved room, read only: its name and layout, their pet and whether it is home. Unsaved changes on the
owner's screen are never part of it, and opening it changes nothing (no walk is settled, no EXP).

post.description: "Chào pet" or "Động viên": a notification to the host, also while their pet is out walking (it waits for them).

"Rủ học": invite the host into the visitor's current study room, or into a new private room with the chosen
subject and rhythm (the room's own settings win when the visitor is already in one). Retry-safe.
